outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 275 mothers with meconium-stained amniotic fluid who gave birth via emergency cesarean section at Wolkite University specialized hospitals in Ethiopia from September 1, 2021, to August 30, 2022
finding: The prevalence of meconium aspiration syndrome was high (28.7%), and thick meconium, meconium-stained amniotic fluid in early labor, and low 1st minute APGAR scores were associated with increased risk.
